_template.label: BOB Workspace
_template.description: Full workspace: Planner, CRM, PRM, Client Work, Finance, Suppliers & Procurement, Reports, AI Workspace. Schema-driven. Designed for the BOB Workspace vault.

items.label: Home
items.desc: Command centre — today, projects, pipeline and upcoming, all on one screen.

items.label: Inbox
items.desc: Universal capture + reminders. Anything you toss in here surfaces at the right time.

items.label: Today
items.desc: Diary view of today's daily note.

items.label: Calendar
items.desc: Week view across daily notes.

items.label: TaskNotes
items.desc: TaskNotes as full markdown task records with status, priority, due date and context.

items.label: Projects
items.desc: Active projects with milestones, owners, statuses — kanban over project notes.

items.label: Dashboard
items.desc: Overview cards — today's tasks, deal momentum, recent contacts, week stats.

items.label: Pipeline
items.desc: Sales pipeline. Deals as markdown notes with stage, deal value, client and follow-up frontmatter.

items.label: Contacts
items.desc: People as markdown notes — name, email, company, last-talked-to cadence, tags.

items.label: Clients
items.desc: Client company profiles — status, regions, contact details, related deals and projects.

items.label: Leads
items.desc: Prospect records — qualification, source, outreach status.

items.label: Campaigns
items.desc: Marketing/sales campaigns — outbound (sequences), inbound (content+ads), or mixed.

items.label: Activities
items.desc: Cross-cutting activity timeline — calls, meetings, telegram/whatsapp/email logs.

items.label: Partners
items.desc: Partner organisations — relationship status, named contacts, joint pipeline.

items.label: Workspace
items.desc: Client delivery workspace: meetings, communications, deliverables, feedback, surveys, testimonials and decisions.

items.label: Customer Invoices
items.desc: Customer invoices, payment status and amounts.

items.label: General Ledger
items.desc: GL work area for chart of accounts, journal entries, trial balances and financial statements.

items.label: Finance Setup
items.desc: Finance setup records: periods, bank accounts, FX rates and inventory/reference setup.

items.label: Tax
items.desc: Tax and compliance work area: VAT, corporate tax, transfer pricing, free-zone status and retention.

items.label: Suppliers
items.desc: Supplier profiles — services, contracts, contacts, spend.

items.label: Supplier Invoices
items.desc: Supplier invoices, three-way match and payment status.

items.label: Purchase Requisitions
items.desc: Internal purchase requests before spend is approved or a PO is issued.

items.label: Purchase Orders
items.desc: Formal supplier purchase orders, approval status and delivery references.

items.label: Productivity
items.desc: Personal productivity — completion rate, streaks, focus blocks, journal volume.

items.label: Pipeline
items.desc: Pipeline coverage and weighted forecast — by stage, owner, source.

items.label: Sales
items.desc: Closed won / lost trends — quota attainment, win rate, average cycle.

items.label: Partners
items.desc: Partner contribution — sourced vs influenced revenue, top tiers.

items.label: Activity
items.desc: Activity mix — calls, meetings, emails by rep and account.

items.label: Team
items.desc: Team members, roles, seats — admin view of your BOB Workspace.

items.label: Base Links
items.desc: Test surface for live Base dashboard widgets and configured Base shortcuts.

items.label: Settings
items.desc: BOB Workspace settings — folders, headings, week start, API connection.

items.label: Playbooks
items.desc: Runnable AI playbooks — step-by-step process recipes with triggers, outcomes and maturity levels.

items.label: Skills
items.desc: Agent skills installed in the vault — category, version, enabled/disabled status.
